purpose: Background 背景; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandBackground](../../lib/src/components/background.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Stateless decorative paint; no global Gallery changes or child rewriting.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. The canonical scene SVGs materialize their finite user-space circle tiles offline, preserving dot positions, radius, paint, opacity and full-scene clipping; runtime renderer limits and child ownership are unchanged.
interface.performance: The public decorative renderer is unchanged; platform profiling retains its measured scope. The Gallery owns preview placement: it may skip fully off-viewport scene-preview painting with a one-logical-pixel guard, retaining the same mounted child, geometry, semantics and pointer path. Visible SVG scenes paint in the existing canvas without a new repaint layer. This is private Gallery composition, not a public IslandBackground option or application-wide culling guarantee.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Gallery scene previews crossing the actual viewport boundary, reversed scrolling, transformed/scaled and resized framework hosts
scenarios.when: A scene becomes fully clipped or partially visible and its child is hovered or activated
scenarios.then: Only fully clipped paint is skipped; visible content paints in the existing canvas and child identity, layout, semantics and input behavior remain. Framework boundary oracle: example/test/background_viewport_test.dart. Native pixel evidence and real OS/Web scope are recorded separately.
